Execute an integrated bibliometric plan

run_plan.Rd

Execute an integrated bibliometric plan

Usage

run_plan(plan, data = NULL)

Arguments

plan

A biblio_plan.

data

Data frame or biblio_project; if missing, plan$source is imported.

Value

Named list of analysis results.

Examples

run_plan(form_plan(),example_biblio())
